parameters.content:
## SETUP REQUIRED

Purpose: secure Voiceflow-facing speed-to-lead backend with validation, idempotency, qualification, and HubSpot contact upsert.

1. Create the server environment variable VOICEFLOW_WEBHOOK_KEY and send the same value from Voiceflow in the x-javedai-key header.
2. Open **Validate and Normalize Request** and keep DRY_RUN = true until tests pass. Change it to false only when HubSpot is connected.
3. On each HubSpot HTTP Request node, select a Header Auth credential whose header is Authorization and whose value is Bearer plus your HubSpot private-app token. Required scopes: contacts read/write.
4. In Workflow Settings, select **JavedAI 99 - Central Error Handler** after all workflows are imported. No static workflow ID is embedded here.
5. Test 401, 400, duplicate, dry-run, create, and update paths before activation.

Expected body fields: event_id, name or first_name/last_name, email and/or phone, company, website, use_case, budget, timeline, and consent_to_contact set to true.

Security: inactive on import; no credentials or personal records are included. Static-data idempotency persists only in active production executions.
